title: Async iterators (for await…of)
description: Async iterables expose `[Symbol.asyncIterator]` and let `for await...of` consume values that arrive over time.

notes: `for await...of` is ONLY valid inside an `async` function (or top-level module).
`[Symbol.asyncIterator]` is a DIFFERENT well-known symbol from `[Symbol.iterator]` — don't mix them up.
`next()` returns a Promise that resolves to `{ value, done }` — the wrapper, not the value, is async.
